messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm opening a refresh PR for the starter-kit quickstart. Primary goals: simplify auth snippets to use the new SDK init pattern, add a short local Docker deploy section, and fix the broken /docs/auth link that cropped up after the nav re-org. PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432. Can eng/devex review today? Aim to merge before EOD Friday.


dan: taking a look now. Saw one broken Node snippet already — missing an await on client.generate, which can cause the example to exit before the token stream. I'll push a tiny patch.

dan: proposed fix for Node snippet:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'open-redwood/1.0', prompt: 'Hello' });
console.log(resp.output_text);
```

maria: perfect, thanks. Also switching examples to RW_API_KEY everywhere (we previously referenced REDSERVER_API_KEY in a few spots).

shrey: quick note — Dedicated / private customers still have legacy env names in our onboarding scripts. We should add a migration section that maps legacy -> current (RED_SERVER_KEY -> RW_API_KEY, RED_CACHE=false -> RW_USE_CACHE=false). I can draft that paragraph.

carol: I can update the Dockerfile and the quickstart repo link. For the local deploy section, can we keep it minimal: build, run, and a single curl auth example? Also suggest we mention the Console token view path: Console -> Settings -> API Tokens so folks know where to copy keys.

maria: yes to minimal Docker flow. For curl example let's use the SDK fallback example (no SDK) so users who want quick curl testing can do it without node/python. Something like:
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood/1.0","input":"hi"}'
```

dan: LGTM. small nit — the API host in the docs should be region-aware (api.redwood.eu for EU customers). Maybe add a footnote about selecting the right host.

maria: good call. I'll add a short sentence and link to the region docs.

carol: also noticed a broken internal link in the troubleshooting section (was pointing to /docs/old-troubleshoot). I'll file a tiny HTML redirect on the site and update the doc.

shrey: about tests — can we add one integration test that runs the quickstart snippet in CI (using a fake key) so we catch snippet regressions? I can add a GH Action that just lints/executes the snippet in dry-run mode.

maria: yes please, that would be great. If you add the GH Action mark it as opt-in via a repo secret so it doesn't run for everyone.

deploy-bot: Preview site for PR #432 is ready: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/pr-432 (expires in 7 days).

maria: awesome, thanks deploy-bot. One more ask — can reviewers mark :eyes: or :+1: on the PR comment once they skim? I'll merge after 1 more +1.

dan: added :eyes: and left the small await fix in a follow-up commit.

carol: done, updated Dockerfile and curl example, left a comment on the PR about the Console token path.

shrey: draft migration table pushed to the PR, added the legacy->current env mapping and a short troubleshooting note for token-permission errors.

maria: thanks everyone — I'll wait for CI, then merge this afternoon if green. Will follow up with a short release note for the onboarding changelog. :thumbsup:
